01 · What is different here

The pressures we see in finance

Digital operational resilience

The EU's DORA regulation sets requirements for ICT risk management, incident reporting and third-party risk for financial entities. AI services you depend on fall inside that scope.

Consequential automated decisions

Under the EU AI Act, systems used to evaluate the creditworthiness of natural persons are classed as high-risk. That brings logging, human oversight and documentation duties.

A ledger that must close correctly

Period close and reconciliation rules are exactly the kind of logic that benefits from formal specification and model checking, not just testing.
